# Vendored Windows x64 Runtime Binaries

This directory is the staging location for third-party Windows x64 runtime executables bundled into Lumina Audio's Windows desktop release package (`<ReleaseDir>/bin/`).

## Staged Artifacts (Git-Ignored)

Run `scripts/prepare_release_deps.ps1` from the repository root to download, SHA256-verify, and populate the following files:

| File | Source | License | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `yt-dlp.exe` | Official [`yt-dlp/yt-dlp`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases) Windows x64 standalone binary | Unlicense (+ PyInstaller bundled licenses) | Media metadata & stream URL resolution |
| `deno.exe` | Official [`denoland/deno`](https://github.com/denoland/deno/releases) `deno-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` | MIT | JavaScript runtime used by `yt-dlp` for YouTube EJS challenges |
| `ffmpeg.exe` | Official [`BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds`](https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases) Windows x64 `lgpl` static build (`ffmpeg.exe` only; no `ffplay.exe`/`ffprobe.exe`) | LGPL | Audio stream remuxing / post-processing |
| `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt` | Generated by `scripts/prepare_release_deps.ps1` | Combined | Merged versions, official URLs, license texts, and LGPL compliance notice (copied alongside `lumina_app.exe`) |

## VC++ 2015–2022 Redistributable (x64) Runtime Dependency

Both the Flutter Windows runner and bundled native components depend on the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 x64 runtime (`vcruntime140.dll`, `vcruntime140_1.dll`, `msvcp140.dll`).

- `app/windows/CMakeLists.txt` invokes `InstallRequiredSystemLibraries` so MSVC runtime DLLs are automatically bundled into Release builds when the Visual Studio C++ Redistributable workload is present on the build machine.
- On machines without bundled runtime DLLs, install the official Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable (x64).

## Usage

```powershell
# Download & SHA256-verify vendored binaries + generate THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/prepare_release_deps.ps1

# Full Windows Release build (prepares deps, ensures core_ffi.dll, builds & verifies Release bundle)
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build_release.ps1
```

> **Note:** Do not commit `.exe`, `.zip`, or generated `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt` files to Git. They are explicitly ignored by the repository root `.gitignore`.
